en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground is a tree‑lined dirt path with a wooden railing. Below the path are closely packed houses with steep, tiled roofs. In the distance on the right stands a prominent church with a tall spire and adjoining buildings, likely forming a historic center. The scene is rural and tranquil. At the bottom left of the card there is a handwritten-style caption.
